question: Should hook transform module-local state be reset on every accepted hooks mapping reload, including when a configured transform file itself is unchanged?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but existing process-local caching allowed stateful transforms to retain module state until restart; choosing generation-scoped instances is a compatibility contract that source inspection cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve generation-scoped instances
options.body: Accept one transform module instance per accepted hooks generation, including state reset for unchanged transforms, and land after refreshing the branch and completing exact-head checks.

options.title: Require selective invalidation
options.body: Preserve unchanged transform instances and request a bounded mechanism that invalidates only edited or replaced transform modules, with equivalent race coverage.

recommendation.title: Approve generation-scoped instances
recommendation.body: Accept one transform module instance per accepted hooks generation, including state reset for unchanged transforms, and land after refreshing the branch and completing exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans both hook module-loading policy and the gateway runtime transaction boundary, making them the strongest available owner for this lifecycle choice.
